name: rust-crate
check: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --offline --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --offline --locked

not_planted.K8: K8 is exercised by python-tooling and symfony-app.

declared.text: User-supplied names are passed to Command as arguments, never through sh -c.

faults.finding: User-supplied names are interpolated into sh -c despite the argv declaration.

neighbour.why_clean: The neighbouring helper passes the name as one argument to printf.

declared.text: Record paths stay beneath the store root.

faults.finding: record_path joins an untrusted name without checking containment under the root.

neighbour.why_clean: The checked neighbour normalizes the path and proves it starts with the canonical root.

declared.text: A count of zero is an answer and is distinct from an absent record.

practiced.text: let n = count.unwrap_or(0); if n == 0 { "no record".into() } else { format!("count={n}") }

faults.finding: render_count treats Some(0) as absent via unwrap_or(0) and n == 0.

neighbour.why_clean: The label renderer matches absence separately from every present label.

declared.text: Credentials never leave the process in failure logs.

faults.finding: write_failure_log dumps the process environment, including credentials.

neighbour.why_clean: The neighbouring logger writes a fixed redaction marker.

declared.text: An unreadable or corrupt store is reported as an error, never served as empty.

faults.finding: read_records swallows the read error and returns an empty Ok vector.

neighbour.why_clean: The writer propagates filesystem errors with the question-mark operator.

declared.text: Intervals are half-open, including their start and excluding their end.

faults.finding: Interval::contains treats the end as inclusive.

neighbour.why_clean: The iterator uses Rust's half-open range expression.

declared.text: Dependencies are pinned to one version and locked.

faults.finding: anyhow is a wildcard "*" in Cargo.toml while the lock names one version.

neighbour.why_clean: The hex dependency is pinned to exactly one locked version.
